arStrings.szText: You can now overexert yourself while Casting {c_important}Flurry{/c}, spending {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"*100|%|]{/c} life when you don't have enough Energy. Spending life to Cast {c_important}Flurry{/c} increases its damage by {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|1%x|]{/c} and your Attack Speed by {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"*100|%|]{/c} for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 2"]{/c} seconds.
